notes: In these mighty gods the ASV writes one determiner for three articles and a demonstrative; the demonstrative takes it and the construct yad keeps a supplied the (rule 41's closing paragraph).
The tripartite clause elleh hem ha-elohim gives the copula to the nominal predicate and leaves the resuming pronoun unrepresented (rules 20 and 22).
kol makkah is a quantifying construct: the supplied generic manner joins the quantifier's unit and the of stays with the rectum (rules 19 and 31).
